units.summary: Adds a method that appends the from-selected-series hint to block meta if absent and keeps hints sorted. It is idempotent and persisted in meta.json.
units.headline: Add SetSelectedSeries to record from-selected-series compaction hint
units.reason: Writes a new value into persisted block meta hints, which other code uses to decide WAL-replay cutoff.
focus: Hint string and sorted order are stable in meta.json for older readers

units.summary: Adds a read-only predicate checking whether the hints contain from-selected-series. It is used by planning, merging and the in-order max time computation.
units.headline: Add FromSelectedSeries hint predicate
units.reason: Simple side-effect-free lookup; the risky behavior is in its callers, which are reviewed separately.

units.summary: New unit test covering absence, set, idempotence and coexistence with the stale hint. Test-only.
units.headline: Test selected-series hint set/get idempotence
units.reason: New test only; cannot affect production behavior.

units.summary: The planner now splits blocks into stale, selected and no-hint classes and plans each separately, preferring no-hint, then stale, then selected. This keeps partial-view hints from being lost by mixing, which would advance the WAL-replay cutoff.
units.headline: Planner segregates selected-series blocks from other compaction classes
units.reason: Changes which blocks get compacted together, affecting persisted data and WAL-replay data-loss protection.
focus: Class ordering cannot starve stale or selected blocks indefinitely
Single-class case still goes through planClass(dms) unchanged
Overlapping blocks of different classes stay unmerged on disk until retention

units.summary: Only the doc comment is updated to mention the selected-series hint.
units.headline: Update planClass doc comment for selected-series hint
units.reason: Comment-only change; no code lines are modified.

units.summary: Merged block meta now keeps the from-selected-series hint when any source has it, and comments are updated. Combined with planner segregation this preserves the hint through compaction.
units.headline: Merged block meta propagates from-selected-series hint
units.reason: Changes persisted hint output of compaction, which feeds inOrderBlocksMaxTime and WAL truncation.
focus: Any-source semantics are safe given the planner segregation
Hint is dropped nowhere else when merging

units.summary: Write now copies the from-selected-series hint from the base meta to the new block meta, like the stale hint. This preserves the hint when rewriting a block.
units.headline: Write propagates from-selected-series hint from base meta
units.reason: Alters persisted block meta of written blocks, affecting WAL-replay cutoff logic.
focus: Other Write callers passing a base meta get the intended hint behavior

units.summary: New happy-path test for CompactSelectedSeries checking eviction, hint, HeadMinTime and metrics. Test-only.
units.headline: Add happy-path test for CompactSelectedSeries
units.reason: New test only; no production code is affected.
